author: Nicolai Sagasser
verification: Fetched from X via twitter-cli from seed-conversation; original author and post URL preserved.
note: Original post did not expose a complete repeatable prompt. Treat this as a real showcase post, not a verified tutorial.
originalText:
I asked Fable to impress me.

I gave it the task to run a Lennard-Jones-molecular dynamic.

400 particles. One force law. The words "gas," "liquid," and "crystal" appear nowhere in the code. I turn the temperature down and watch them condense into droplets, then freeze into a lattice. Thermodynamics, emerging from nothing but Newton.

It took less then 2 minutes to calculate and generate. 

I'm impressed. @AnthropicAI
